༄༅/ /slob dpon bshad sgrub ming can gyi rnam thar zur ba gzur gnas dga' byed bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /slob dpon bshad sgrub ming can gyi rnam thar zur ba gzur gnas dga' byed bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rnam dkar legs tshogs tshogs gnyis kyis bskrun sku mchog mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis mdzes/ /rnam dag chos tshul tshul bzhin ston mdzad gsung mchog yan lag drug cu mnga'/ /rnam mang chos kun kun nas mngon gzigs thugs mchog chags thog mi mnga' ba/ /gang la mnga' ba lha mi'i ston pa shākya'i rgyal por gus phyag 'tshal/ /ring mo nyid nas mngon par sangs rgyas kyang*/ /sems dpa'i tshul gyis rab 'byams zhing rnams su/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa sgrub pa'i khur bzhes pa/ /rgyal tshab mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ /thugs bskyed smon lam dag pa'i 'tshams sbyor gyis/ /thub pa'i lung rtogs dam chos ma lus pa/ /ji bzhin 'dzin mdzad klu sgrub thogs med sogs/ /'phags yul mkhas grub tshogs rnams kun la 'dud/ /byang phyogs rgyud du sngon med dam pa'i chos/ /bsgyur zhing dgongs 'grel 'chad nyan la sogs kyis/ /thub bstan srol bzung dar zhing rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /lo paṇa bka' drin can rnams rtag tu bsngags/ /mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel bcas pa'i tshig don rnams/ /ji bzhin thugs chud gzhan la legs 'doms pa/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chos rje bu ston dang*/ /blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis par grags la 'dud/ /blo bzang nyin byed dbang po gshegs pa'i shul/ /mkhas mang rgyu skar tshogs rnams gzhung lugs mkhar/ /rtse dgas rol dang lhan cig me 'khyer 'ga'/ /legs bshad gshog bskyod 'phur lding lta bur brel/ ༈ /de yang sngon du bdag gis ni/ /tshe 'dir thos bsam ji lta bur/ /byas pa'i rnam thar thun mong ba/ /gzhan gyis bskul ltar rgyas tsam zhig /bris zin par du brkos shing spel/ /de las lhag pa'i rnam thar zhig /bdag la gtan yod ma yin kyang*/ / dad ldan gzur gnas bu slob 'gas/ /nyid kyi rnam thar thun mong dang*/ /thun mong min pa'i khyad par zhig /cis kyang dgos zhes bskul ba dang*/ /'ga' zhig sngon gyi skye brgyud dang*/

/dge sbyor byas tshul ji lta bu/ /yin rnams ma sbas gsal ba ru/ /zhu zhes bskul ba ma bzlog par/ /'dod pa'i rjes su 'brang ste bri/ /de la rnam thar thun mong ba/ /tshe 'dir dngos su byas pa ste/ /de ni sngon du brjod pa dang*/ /mthong ba las ni shes zin kyang*/ /bskul ba'i don du slar yang ni/ /bsdus te 'ga' zhig bsnan byas shing*/ /dngos kyi nyams snang dang 'brel ba'i/ /thun mong ma yin rnam thar ni/ /nam mkha'i padmo'i rjes 'gro yang*/ gzugs brnyan lta bu mtshon tsam brjod/ /de yang las smon 'brel ba yis/ / dbus su song ste grwa tshang du/ /zhugs nas lo 'go phyed gnyis tsam/ /bsdus grwar bsdad de bsdus gzhung dpe/ /shog grangs nyis brgya lhag tsam zhig /blo la bzung zhing byang bar byas/ /bsdus gzhung che chung kun gyi don/ /myur du go zhing shes gyur pas/ /sngon gyi bag chags yin 'dra bsam/ /tshul der ma zad rnam 'grel gyi/ /yan lag blo rtags rnam gnyis dang*/ /gzhung gi cha 'ga' dpe 'dzin byas/ /de ltar sbyangs pa'i 'bras rtags la/ /bsdus gzhung dpe mang bkod zin cing*/ /blo rtags gnyis kyi bar yang brkos/ /rwa ba stod dang se rar yang*/ /bsdus grwa'i gzhung gi tshogs lang dang*/ /dam bca' dag kyang 'ga' re bzhag /gzhung la zhugs nas se ra yi/ /tshogs chen dbus su ri ra'i skabs/ / tshogs lang lan bdun legs par byas/ /dbu phar 'dul mdzod bzhi po kun/ blor bzung skyor zhing ma brjed thog /lha par ming bdag byas nas ni/ /rgyud grwar zhugs shing de nyid du/ /dam bca' lan gsum bar du bzhag /bkra shis lhun por bsnyen rdzogs ched/ /song tshe de kha'i mkhas 'ga' dang*/ /brgal brtag byas pas de dag gis/ /tshogs chen dam bca' bzhag na legs/ /zer yang chags sdang 'ong snyam ste/ /'jog par khas ni ma blangs so/ /de nas se 'bras dga' ldan du/ /dam bca' bzhag ste rang yul la/ /'ongs pas legs smon 'brel ba yis/

/bka' 'gyur tshar phyin bsgrags pa dang*/ /mtshan nyid grwa tshang 'di nyid kyi/ /thog ma'i bla mar legs par bskos/ /de tshe ko'u shri'i zhabs nyid dang*/ /lhan cig thabs shes zung 'brel gyis/ /grwa tshang gsar du bdebs pa dang*/ /bsgrig lam kun spyod gsar bcos te/ /'chad nyan legs par 'phel bar byas/ /de ltar chos dang 'jig rten gyis/ /grwa tshang 'di la thog ma ru/ /phan 'dogs nges par che na yang*/ /byas bzo med pa 'ga' zhig gis/ /ma shes mod kyang gzhan dag mnyes/ /de bzhin rgyud grwa gsar btsugs kyi/ /thog ma'i slob dpon byas nas kyang*/ /rgyud 'grel bskyed rdzogs 'chad rtsom sogs/ / rgyud grwar phan 'dogs du ma byas/ /mdor na dgon 'di'i mkhan po dang*/ /rgyud pa'i slob dpon lan gnyis re/ /byas thog dbang bskur 'chad rtsom gyis/ bstan dang 'gro la phan mang bsgrubs/ /grwa tshang slob dpon byed pa nas/ /da ltar rang lo don gsum par/ /mdo sngags dgongs 'grel bstan bcos kyi/ /rtsom dpe po ti bcu lhag tsam/ /byung 'di sngon nas da yi bar/ /par grub yongs rdzogs 'ga' re dang*/ /le tshan rang rang 'dod pa bzhin/ /phyogs 'di'i stod smad g.yas g.yon dang*/ /pho brang nang sogs rgya sog gi /yul du 'khyer te dar bar gyur/ /tshul der ma zad se ra yi/ /grwa tshang bla ma dka' ram 'gas/ / dgos tshul byung ltar du ma zhig /snga phyir par te bskur byas pas/ /se 'bras dge gsum rgyud pa 'gar/ /phul dang bris pas dar gyur zhes/ /grwa tshang bla ma nyid kyis gsung*/ /nga la rnam thar yod 'dod na/ /'di nyid rnam thar mchog tu zungs/ /phyogs 'dir snga nas da yi bar/ /mkhas pa ma byon min na yang*/ /smon lam bzang po'i 'bras smin las/ /rtsom pa'i 'brel pa mang po zhig /'jog pa'i dus bab skal ldan pa/ /bdag nyid kho na yin nam snyam/ /gzhan yang sbyin bdag dad ldan 'gas/ /bos tshe yul grong de dag gi /pho mo skya ser mang po

la/ /rang rang 'dod pa'i chos lung dang*/ /bslab pa ster dang ban bon 'gas/ /u tshugs nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ /de dag so so'i 'dod pa bzhin/ /de ba rdzogs ched dpe du ma'i/ /'don tshul g.yar khral tshul du ni/ dbang med byed dgos mang byung yang*/ /chos sam de min ma shes mod/ /bsam ba rdzogs byas dge bar gyur/ /gson gshin don du rdo rje 'jigs byed dang*/ /rnam snang cho ga'i tshul la mang zhugs te/ /yul chos dbang byas gzhan gyi don bsgrubs kyang*/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'dres mar byas snyam sems/ /de nas nang gi rnam thar ni/ /rang rgyud 'dul tshul dang bstun te/ /cung zad brjod bya de yang ni/ /bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung rigs las/ lhag pa'i lha yi zhal mthong tsam/ /yon tan gtso bor mi 'dzin par/ / rgyud la byams pa snying rje dang*/ /sems bskyed lta ba rnam dag sogs/ /skyes na yon tan mchog tu bzhed/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro ba/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i 'jug sgo ste/ /'di med bsam gtan gzugs med dang*/ / mngon shes yod kyang rgyal bstan la/ /zhugs pa min na nang pa yi/ /dam chos khyad 'phags gzhan lta ci/ /de nyid gzhir byas ngan song dang*/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal khyad par kun/ /legs par shes nas thar 'dod blo/ /yang yang goms byas nges 'byung mchis/ /gang la nges 'byung med gyur na/ /de la thar pa don gnyer blo/ /rnam dag yod pa mi srid phyir/ / thar 'dod ces pa'ang tshig tsam 'gyur/ kha cig yid la 'di snyam sems/ /nges 'byung blo la ma sbyangs par/ /thog ma nyid nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang thob 'dod 'byung srid pas/ /nges 'byung med kyang thar 'dod dang*/ /sangs rgyas don gnyer 'byung ngo zer/ /de la'ang nges 'byung phyogs gcig tsam/ /yod kyang mtshan nyid ma rdzogs phyir/ /sangs rgyas thob 'dod don gnyer yang*/ /phyogs gcig tsam ste tshul 'di la/ /brgal brtag mang yang 'dir mi brjod/

/rang la chung ngu'i dus su yang*/ /snying rje bcos min rang chas su/ /yod cing bsam shes byams snying rje/ /yang yang goms byas da lta ni/ /tshig tsam ma yin bcos min mchis/ /de phyir nyams len snying po mchog /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /gzhan phan lhag bsam rnam dag dang*/ /byang chub sems kyi dmigs rnam la/ /nyin re bzhin du goms byas pas/ /lhag bsam rnam dag yod nges kyang*/ /byang chub sems ni skyes so zhes/ /brjod cing khas blangs nus ma lags/ /byang chub sems ni skyes gyur na/ /yon tan gzhan dag med na yang*/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' ru/ /'gyur bar nges phyir rang gis rang*/ /byang chub sems dpar 'dod mi rigs/ /rang gis rlom pa'i dbang byas na/ /theg pa chen po'i gzhung mang la/ /thos bsam 'di tsam byas pa dang*/ /byams dang snying rje lhag bsam sogs/ /sems bskyed skye ba'i rgyu rnams la/ /yang yang de tsam 'bad byas pas/ byang chub sems ni bskyed snyam zhing*/ /gal te de ni ma skyes na/ /theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs don/ /lung dang rigs pas gtan phab pa'i/ /'bras bu mchog de ma byung bas/ /lus sems ngal ba brgya phrag gis/ /theg chen la 'bad don chung zhing*/ /gzhan la bshad pa'ang tshig tsam snyam/ /de phyir byang chub sems mchog ni/ /kho bo'i rgyud dang ring ma song*/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba la/ /grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i lugs kyi dbang*/ /mchog dman tha dad yod srid mod/ /kun kyang lhag pa shes rab kyi/ /bslab pa skye ba'i dmigs par 'gyur/ /nang pa'i grub mtha' rnam bzhi las/ /dma' ba bye brag smra ba'i lugs/ /phyi rol pas ni rtag pa'i bdag khas len bye smras de bkag nas/ rtag gcig rang dbang can nyid kyis/ /stong pa'i bdag med bsgoms byas pas/ /thar pa thob par 'gyur zhes 'dod/ /de bzhin mdo sde pa dang ni/ / sems tsam dbu ma rang rgyud pa/ /rnams kyi lugs la'ang khyad par yod/

/de kun bsgom bya yin mod kyi/ /rang lugs dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i/ /lugs bzhin lta ba bsgom dgos shing*/ /de yang mgon po klu sgrub lugs/ /dpal ldan zla bas tshig gsal dang*/ /dbu ma 'jug par gtan phab bzhin/ /shes dgos 'phags pa yab sras lugs/ /ji bzhin 'grel mdzad rje bla ma'i/ / gsung rab tshogs las 'byung zhing ltos/ /bdag kyang rgyal ba gnyis pa de'i/ / rjes 'brang mgon po klu sgrub kyi/ /lugs ltar lta ba'i skor la sbyangs/ /de tshe 'phags pas byin brlabs pas/ /rje yi gsung ltar nges don gyi/ /lta ba'i gnad la nges pa rnyed/ /de yang don dam dpyod byed kyi/ /rigs pas dpyad na mi rnyed tsam/ /dka' ba min gyi rang bzhin gyis/ /stong sang nam mkha' lta bu la/ /ming rkyang btags yod tsam zhig gi /dkar nag las 'bras la sogs pa'i/ /bya byed thams cad gnod med du/ /'jog tshul shes de dka' ba yin/ /mtshon na 'das pa'i dngos po rnams/ /da lta med kyang spyir yod cing*/ /de bzhin ma 'ongs dngos rnams kun/ /da lta med kyang yod nges su/ 'dod dgos dkar nag las 'bras sogs/ /'khor 'das kun kyang rig shes kyis/ /dpyad nas rnyed par mi 'jog kyang*/ /ma dpyad tha snyad blo ngo ltar/ /kun rdzob tu ni yod par 'dod/ /de yang me long chu nang gi /gzugs brnyan bzhin du kun rdzob rnams/ /bden par snang yang snang bzhin stong*/ /stong bzhin snang bas gzhi gcig la/ /bden gnyis 'du ba'i 'jog tshul de/ / legs par shes na lta ba la/ /mkhas par 'dod kyi gzhan du na/ /rang bzhin grub pa'i chos rdul tsam/ /med ces tshig gis brgya brjod kyang*/ /sgra spyi zlos pa tsam du zad/ /de ltar rang bzhin stong pa'i don/ /rigs pa brgya phrag dag gis ni/ /yang yang dpyad cing nges byas pas/ /dpyad bsgom tsam zhig yod nges kyang*/ /bying rgod rags pa'i bran gyur te/ /zhi lhag gnyis kyi dbang byas pa'i/ /'jog bsgom phyogs gtogs tsam zhig las/

/mtshan nyid tshang ba bskyed ma nus/ /'on kyang bslab gsum nang tshan gyi/ /shes rab bslab pa yongs nges te/ /lhag pa shes rab bslab pa la/ /kun rdzob don dam la dmigs gnyis/ /kun rdzob rig pa'i gnas lnga po/ /ci rigs shes pa'i shes rab dang*/ /don dam bdag med phra rags kun/ /rtogs pa'i blo gros nyid la bshad/ /lhag pa bsam gtan bslab pa yang*/ /phyogs tsam yod de de la ni/ / kun rdzob don dam la dmigs dang*/ /dpyad bsgom 'jog bsgom rnam pa gnyis/ /spyir ni dge ba'i dmigs rten zhig /de la ring thung gang yin kyang*/ / rtse gcig gnas pa tsam byung na/ /ting 'dzin yin zhes sngags rim las/ / bshad cing phyi nang gnyis ka yi/ /ting 'dzin bsgom tshul mang 'byung ste/ /bsam gtan zhes pa'i grangs su 'gro /sngags kyi skabs su lha sku sogs/ /dmigs rten byas nas dpyad bsgom dang*/ /'jog bsgom bya ba'i tshul bshad ltar/ / 'bad pas brtan po ma byung yang*/ /zhi lhag rjes mthun gyis bsdus pa'i/ / bsaman gtan shes rab zung 'brel tsam/ /yod par rang gi tshad mas nges/ / lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa la/ /rnam pa mang yang mdor bsdu na/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi/ /tshul khrims bslab pa ci nus bsrung*/ /tshul khrims bslab pa phra ba ni/ /las 'bras phra zhing phra ba ru/ /'dus phyir sangs rgyas kho na'i yul/ /da lta'i so skyes ga la nus/ /de bzhin phyin drug phyogs tsam ste/ /chos kyi sby-in pa du ma dang*/ /dge 'dun mchod de yon du ma/ /phul zhing rang gi lus longs spyod/ /dge kun gzhan la gtong ba'i sems/ /rgyun tu goms byas sbyin pa dang*/ /tshul khrims sngar bshad lta bu ste/ /rang don kho na yid byed dang*/ /bral te byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshul khrims mchog tu mdo las bshad/ /chos kyi phyir ru dka' spyad dang*/ /chos la nges sems bzod pa rnams/ /rtag tu yod cing sdug bsngal kun/ /dang du len cig gnod pa

la/ /bzod ba'i bzod pa'ang yod pa'i khul/ /dge la spro ba'i brtson 'grus ni/ /rtag tu yod cing sems can don/ /bya dka' mang po bsgrub pa dang*/ /byang chub don du ngan 'gro ru/ /bskal bar gnas kyang mi skyo ba'i/ /go cha'i brtson 'grus yod pa'i khul/ /de nas bsam gtan shes rab rnam pa gnyis/ /gong du brjod zin yum gyi mdo las ni/ /dgon nam grong sogs dag tu gnas byas kyang*/ /nyan rang yid byed dman pa'i sems bor te/ /gzhan gyi don du byang chub bsgrub bzhin par/ /gzugs sogs 'dod yon lnga la spyod gyur kyang*/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa'i dbang byas pa'i/ /bsam gtan gnas dang dben pa'i mchog tu bshad/ /༈ yang ni thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /rnam thar rmi lam bzang tsam yan/ /dgos zhes nan tan bskul ba'i lan/ /yang dag 'debs rgyu mi snang yang*/ /bskul ba'i ngo bzlog ma nus par/ /rmi lam bzang po thar thor zhig/ byung ba'i rnam thar thun mong min/ /gzugs brnyan tsam zhig brjod par bya/ /de yang gzhon nu'i dus kyi tshe/ /sangs rgyas lta bu'i sku 'ga' zhig /shar gyi phyogs kyi nam mkha' nas/ /nub phyogs 'byon pa re gnyis rmis/ /de ni ci yin shes ma byung*/ /snga sor thub dbang byams pa yi/ /sku dang sku brnyan ci rigs pa/ / lan mang rmi lam 'byung ba zhig /yod kyang phyis su de mi snang*/ /mtshan nyid bla mar bskos pa'i skabs/ /nga ni lung pa zhig gi nang*/ /shar du phyogs nas yod pa'i tshe/ /bya dngos brag rtse'i nam mkha' na/ /ston pa sku mdog gser btso ma'i/ /mdangs ltar 'od gsal rab mdzes pa/ /skyes bu chen po'i tshad tsam zhig /bzhugs shing rang gi mdun ngos gyi/ /shar phyogs nam mkha'i dbyings nyid nas/ /'jam dbyangs dmar ser 'od dang bcas/ /rab mdzes sku zhig nub phyogs su/ /'byon gyin 'dug par shugs drag pos/ /dad cing gsol 'debs byed pa na/ /tshur byon bdag gi mdun du sleb/

/mgyogs par phyag 'tshal snyam pa'i tshe/ /byed long med par rang la thim/ /gnyid sad dga' spros lus sems brtas/ /byin gyis brlabs pa yin nam snyam/ /gang ltar dga' ba'i rmi lam yin/ khri ba sngon ma byed pa'i dus/ /nub kyi phyogs nas ston pa'i sku/ /'od dang bcas pa che tsam zhig /bzhugs zhing de yi thugs ka nas/ /'od zer skar mda' lta bu gnyis/ /bshibs te byung ba'i 'od zer gcig /rang gi mgo thog rgyang ring song*/ /gcig ni nga yi mgo thog tu/ /zug gam ma zug the tshom zhing*/ /zug na dga' snyam sems pa'i tshe/ /gnyid sad yid la dga' ba skyes/ /de tshe jo bo'i lha khang thog /khri steng rje nyid bzhugs 'dug pa/ /mthong nas byis skas btsugs pa'i thog /song nas phyag dbang zhu rmis kyang*/ /bar chad cung zad yod par shes/ /lam gtso'i 'grel pa rtsom pa'i skabs/ /nga ni gnas bzang zhig tu ni/ /kha ni shar du phyogs gnas tshe/ /mdun thad shar phyogs nam mkha' nas/ /mgon po klu sgrub zhabs kyi sku/ /gser mdog lta bu rab mdzes shing*/ /yid 'phrog mdangs dang rab ldan pa/ /skyes bu chen po'i tshad tsam zhig /nub phyogs 'byon gyin 'dug pa la/ /'di ni 'phags mchog klu sgrub bo/ /snyam ste dad cing thar sbyar bas/ /skad cig nga yi mdun thad byon/ /dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur ston bzhin du/ /rang la thim song gnyid sad tshe/ /'di ni nges par byin rlob pa'i/ /rmi ltas bzang po zhig yin nges/ /snyam du bsam zhing yid la bzung*/ /rgyud bla'i bsdus don rtsom pa'i skabs/ /byams sku dmar po rab mdzes shing*/ /yid 'phrog byams pa dngos lta bu/ /'od dang bcas zhig bdun gyi mkhar/ /byon gzhugs byin rlabs mdzad pa la/ /dad shugs drag pos gsol 'debs dang*/ /gnyid sad dga' spro che skyes shing*/ /nga la ya mtshan che bsam pa'i/ /bab 'brel de 'dra ga la yod/ /snyam du shar pas dga' rab yin/ /gzhan yang sman bla mi 'khrugs pa/

/'od dpag med gsum dngos lta bu/ /rmi lam lan 'ga' byung gyur te/ /gsol 'debs mang du byas pa yi/ / thugs rje yin nam snyam du bsam/ /yang gcig jo bo'i lha khang steng/ /'jam dbyangs 'jigs byed rje rnam gsum/ /bsgrigs nas bzhugs pa rmis pa byung*/ / na ning bcu pa'i nang nyid du/ /nga ni lam nas shar phyogs su/ /'gro ba'i mdun thad shar ngos nas/ /mi gnyis bshibs te 'ong ba yi/ /g.yas kyi de nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /yin par mthong nas rgyugs byas te/ /rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ /gang du 'byon zhes tshig brjod cing*/ /sku la 'jus shing 'khyud pa na/ /gnyid sad dga' spro khyad can skyes/ /bde mchog rgyud 'grel de rtsom tshe/ /rje nyid 'byon gyin yod do zhes/ /sgra 'ur bcas te byung ba na/ /bltas pas rje nyid 'byon 'dug pas/ / dad cing phyag byar 'dod pa na/ /gnyis sad dga' ba cung zad skyes/ /gzhan yang rje yi rtogs brjod kyi/ /'grel ba byed dus khri steng na/ /rje nyid bzhugs la phyag 'tshal rmis/ /de sogs gzhan yang yod gyur kyang*/ /khyad 'phags yin nam snyam pa ni/ /dris lan 'grel ba de rtsom pa'i/ /thog tha bar gsum dag tu ni/ /rje nyid shin tu mdzes pa'i sku/ /lta bas chog mi shes pa zhig /'dzum pa dang ldan paṇa zhwa dang*/ /chos gos gsol ba lha lta bu/ /snga phyi ma 'gyur gcig pa nyid/ /lan gsum zlos te byung nas ni/ /dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur ston rmis pa/ /'di ni nges par dga' rab zhig /yin nam snyam du ma brjed yod/ / 'ga' zhig da lta brjed song zhing*/ /sgrol ma'i sku stod dngos bstan te/ /sku smad sprin du sbas pa dang*/ /nu ma g.yas pa'i nu zho ni/ /rang la blud pa sogs kyang rmis/ /gzhan yang bde mchog 'jigs byed sogs/ /lha 'ga'i sku brnyan rmi lam du/ /byung ba yod de rmi lam la/ /nges pa med pas 'dir ma bkod/

/spy-ir ni gzhan la phan thogs pa'i/ /dpe rtsom byed pa'i dus su ni/ /rmi lam bzang po re 'byung bas/ /rmi lam bzang tsam mang du byung*/ /rmi lam sgyu ma mig 'phrul sogs/ /snang ba ltar du ma grub pas/ /de la bden pa'i dngos po ru/ /bzung bar bya ba ga la yod/ /thun mong ma yin rnam thar gzugs brnyan dang*/ /rmi lam lta bur bstan phyir rmi lam du/ /'khrul ba'i snang ba snga phyir 'byung ba 'ga'/ / 'khrul gtam lta bur gzhan gyi 'dod ngor bsgrags/ /༈ da ni dge sbyor gzhan 'ga' zhig /ji ltar byas pa'i tshul tsam zhig /dad ldan dag gis bskul ba ltar/ /brjod kyis rang nyid sgrogs phyir min/ /de yang nyin zhag phrug gcig la/ /mtshon na gzhan rnams shes 'gyur bas/ /nang bar ltung bshags nas 'byung sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang sems nyis brgya dang*/ /nyi shu'i skor gyi mtshan brjod de/ /phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa dang*/ /skyabs 'gro smon 'jug sdom len zhig /tshad med bzhi dang bcas la 'bad/ /de nas 'gyur sngags gnyis brjod de/ /dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po dang*/ /'jam dbyangs gnyis dang dbyangs can ma'i/ /snying po brjod de dmigs skor gyi/ /rim pas ngag la byin rlabs gnyis/ /de nas 'jam dbyangs dkar po yi/ /snying po nyer gcig bzla ba dang*/ /wā gi shwa ra bcwo lnga tsam/ /'od zer can dang ri khrod ma/ /sor 'brang gdugs dkar nor rgyun ma/ /ku ru ku le tsunda dang*/ /khro gnyer can dang ral gcig ma/ /'byung 'dul lha mo nag mo dang*/ /seṅge'i sgra dang sman bla dang*/ /bde gshegs spyi snying gtsug tor can/ /klu dbang rnam sras 'khor bcas kyi/ /sngags rnams lan ni bdun re dang*/ /gtsug tor 'bar ba zla ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje sder mo stobs po che/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring sogs/ /brjod de lha tshogs de dag ni/ /ma brjed tsam dang dran tsam byas/ /༈ de nas rnam 'joms mngon rtogs dang*/

/gzungs ring tshar gcig 'bring po gsum/ /gzungs thung de las mang tsam brjod/ /rta mgrin phyag rdor gtum po dang*/ /mi g.yo mgon gsum tshogs zhing du/ /byas te yan lag bdun pa'i mthar/ /rang la bstim nas rta mgrin sogs/ /de dang de ru rim bsgoms te/ /rta mgrin phyag rdor rnam gnyis kyi/ /sngags ni ci 'grub tsam zhig dang*/ /mi g.yo mgon gyi snying po ni/ /phreng skor gcig tsam rgyun tu brjod/ /༈ de nas tshe dpag 'khor bcas rnams/ /tshogs zhing byas te phyag mchod sogs/ /yan lag bdun dang de yi mjug/nyi gzhon 'char ka ma nyid dang*/ /gsol 'debs byas mthar rang nyid la/ /bstims nas der bsgoms sa bon gyis/ /snod bcud nus pa phun tshogs sogs/ /bkug nas rang la bstim pa dang*/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyang*/ /tshe dpag med kyi rnam pa ru/ /spyan drangs bstim nas der bsgoms te/ /gzungs thung brgya tshar gzungs ring kyang*/ /ci 'grub bzlas te dmigs skor byas/ /de nas nam mkhar pad sdong steng*/ /seng khrir thub pa'i dbang po'i mthar/ /byams pa 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs/ /phyag rdor de mthar g.yas g.yon rgyab/ /rgya cher zab mo lta brgyud dang*/ /rdo rje 'chang la sngags brgyud kyi/ /bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba dang*/ /steng du rje dang jo bo la/ /dngos kyi bla mas bskor ba zhig /zur du byas shing de kun gyi/ /mthar ni rgyud sde bzhi 'brel gyi/ /lha tshogs rnams dang sangs rgyas dang*/ /byang sems nyan rang dpa' bo dang*/ / mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs rnams kyis/ /bskor ba bskyed cing spyan drangs bstim/ /so sor phyag dang mchod pa sogs/ /yan lag bdun pa rgyas tsam dang*/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs kyang ton/ /slar yang gsol 'debs tshigs bcad dang*/ /tshig lhug byas pa lan bdun sogs/ /so sor brjod cing nges 'byung dang*/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /phyin drug bslab gsum rim gnyis sogs/

/skye ba'i gsol gdab lan mang dang*/ /skye kun rjes su 'dzin pa yi/ /gsol 'debs la sogs byas ba'i mthar/ /'od kyi rnam par rang nyid kyi/ /snying khar thim nas byin rlabs par/ /mos te nges 'byung byams snying rje/ /lhag bsam sems bskyed lta ba yi/ /dmigs skor tshig tsam ma yin par/ /yid khul nges pa dag la 'bad/ /de tshe spyod pa phyin drug la/ /slob ba'i bsam pa shugs drag pos/ /'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po yi/ /spyod pa ji bzhin spyod 'gyur pa'i/ /smon lam skabs 'dir ma zad kyi/ /sngar nas bsams shing legs par btab/ /'di ni nga yi sems bskyed du/ /go bar gyis la nyams su longs/ /༈ de nas thub dbang byams 'jam dbyangs/ /spyan ras gzigs dang phyag rdor du/ /rim bzhin bsams te de dag gi /snying po phreng skor re tsam brjod/ /de nas dam tshig rdo rje yi/ /bsgom bzlas byas nas spyi gtsug tu/ /rdor sems bskyed bstim yig brgya ni/ /nyer gcig tsam re brjod par byas/ /de nas gsang 'dus rgyas bsdus las/ /gtso cher bsdus pa'i bsgoms bzlas dang*/ /'jigs byed bcu gsum dpa' gcig gnyis/ /gtso cher bdud las rnam rgyal gyi/ /zhi khro'i bsgom bzlas byas pa'i mthar/ /bcu gsum lha tshogs snying kha ru/ /bkod de bzlas pa ci 'grub byas/ /de nas bde mchog rgyas bsdus las/ /gtso cher lha lnga'i bsgom bzlas byas/ /mjug tu lus dkyil lha rdzogs par/ /lus la gsal btab de dag gi /snying po bsdus pa hūṃ baṃ sogs/ /ci 'grub go cha'i sngags gnyis dang*/ /rtsa sngags bcas bzlas 'od gsal du/ /bsdus nas ldang zhing smon lam byas/ /de nas kun rig tshogs zhing ni/ / zur du bkod ltar gsal btab nas/ /yan lag bdun byas gsol btab mthar/ /snying khar bkod de snying po rnams/ /ci 'grub bzlas shing sbyong rgyud nas/ /'byung ltar rigs lnga'i lngags ring rnams/ /ci 'grub bzlas shing 'jug sdud byas/

/de nas gzhan zhig byas mod kyang*/ /ma bkod mtshan brjod tshar gcig bsgrags/ /bde gsang gnyis kyi rgyud dag las/ /le'u re gnyis la sogs pa/ /ci 'grub ton te snga dro yi/ /'don pa'i rim pa 'grub par byas/ /༈ de nas dpe la blta ba dang*/ /rtsom pa'i rim pa la sogs pa/ / lugs gnyis bya ba ci rigs dang*/ /thar pa chen pau nas 'byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi mtshan/ /rdzogs par logs su bkod pa dang*/ /sprin chen mdo dang mun sel dang*/ /me tog tshogs dang pad dkar dang*/ /sangs rgyas bcu pa bkra shis brgyad/ /dra ba can 'od khye'u zhus mdo/ /sangs rgyas dbu rgyan stobs bskyed dang*/ /mdo sde rim lnga gser 'od dang*/ /spang skong phyag rgya nas 'byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan rnams dang*/ /lnga stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu nas/ /gsungs pa'i mtshan sngags rab spel ba/ /brgya lhag skor dang gzhan yang ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mdo nyid nas/ /'byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcu rnams dang*/ /sangs rgyas bcu gnyis sar 'byung ba'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa bcu gnyis dang*/ /'jam dpal zhing bkod nas 'byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan bcas ni/ /nyi ma gcig la 'don pa'am/ /yang na don zhags gzungs ring dang*/ /gtsug tor dri med gzungs ring dang*/ /gsang ba ring bsrel rgyan 'bum gsum/ /ston pa nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi/ /gzungs ring rnams dang stong 'gyur dang*/ /kun bzang gzungs ring zhes bya dang*/ /dkon mchog ye shes ta la dang*/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo stong chen gzungs/ /'chi med rnga sgra sgo mtha' yas/ /rnam snang 'od kyi rgyal po yi/ /gzungs ring gnyis dang dpal chen dang*/ /rma bya'i yang snying 'dzam la dang*/ /nor rgyun gnyis kyi gzungs ring dang*/ /'jam dbyangs sdig pa zhi byed dang*/ /sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob sngags/ /sher phyin mtshan sngags lang gshegs sngags/ /nyi khri bsdus gzungs de yi sngags/

/stong phrag brgya pa gzung 'gyur dang*/ /brgyad stong ting 'dzin rgyal po'i sngags/ /phal bo che sngags phar phyin bcu/ /thob 'gyur tshogs bdag bdud gzhom sngags/ /sangs rgyas yan lag dang ldan dang*/ / tshigs bcad gnyis pa sgo drug gzungs/ /'phags pa gdon mi za ba dang*/ / sdig sgrib kun 'joms chags pa med/ /yangs pa'i grong khyair 'jug pa dang*/ / 'don pa 'bum 'gyur 'gro ba'i sngags/ /smon lam don 'grub mi brjed gzungs/ /gos thob yid 'ong tshig btsan dang*/ /las 'grub mchog thob sngags rnams ni/ /nyi ma gcig la 'don par byas/ /mdor na sngon dus gzungs sngags dang*/ /sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan de rnams/ /nyin gcig la ni rdzogs byas kyang*/ /da lta 'don rgyu gzhan mang stabs/ /re mos byas te 'don par brtson/ /phyi dro slar yang mtshan brjod dang*/ /stong pa nye ba'i sras chen brgyad/ /ji la lha mo nag mo yi/ /mtshan brgya brgyad pa rnams las ni/ /gsum re re mos byed pa dang*/ /gzhan yang sngags tshan du ma zhig /logs su bris nas yod pa dang*/ /sdud pa rdor gcod mngon rtogs rgyan/ /lam sgron lam gtso rjes mdzad dang*/ /rin po che yi mtha' nyid dang*/ /'jam dpal gnas pa chos bzhi'i mdo/ /chos bcu 'da' ka ye shes dang*/ /'du shes bcu gcig rgyal blos zhus/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi/ /mtshan mchog brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang*/ /bzang spyod rnams las gang thub ton/ /gzhan yang brgya rtsa bsdus pa dang*/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg gnyis/ /rkyen dbang ma gtogs ma chags tsam/ /sngon dus sgrol ma rnam rgyal ma'i/ /gzungs ring tshar ni nyer gcig re/ / da lta 'don rgyu gzhan mang stabs/ /de gnyis bcwo lnga bcu gsum nas/ /ma tha bdun re sngon dus nas/ /da lta'i bar du ci tsam zhig /brel ba byung yang chags pa med/ /sgrol ma'i yi ge bcu pa dang*/ /dam bcas gzungs dang rnam rgyal ma'i/ /gzungs thung rnams kyang brgya rtsa re/

/gzhan yang mi 'khrugs pa yi gzungs/ /phal cher nyer gcig re brjod cing*/ /byams pa'i gzungs ring 'jam dpal kyi/ /shes rab blo 'phel spyan ras gzigs/ /bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs ring rnams/ /sngon tshe nyer gcig re ton kyang*/ /da lta phal cher bcwo lnga dang*/ /bcu gcig dgu dang ma tha bdun/ /de bzhin tshul khrims rnam dag dang*/ /don zhags gzungs thung spyan ras gzigs/ /dran dang yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gzungs/ /uṣṇi ṣa dang gser bzang dang*/ /gtsug tor dri med gzungs thung dang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye ge brgya/ /bai ḍūrya snang gzungs rnams kyang*/ /bcwo lnga ma tha bdun tsam zhig /ci tsam brel yang ma chags so/ /༈ de nas mtshan mo 'go nye nas/ /bde mchog bskyed chog bsdus pa la/ /brten nas padma 'dab stong steng*/ /'khor lo lnga bskyed dbus su ni/ /seng khri pad nyi'i gdan steng du/ /bde mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ /dbyer med byas nas bskyed pa yi/ /mtha' skor 'khor lo lnga yi steng*/ /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang*/ /'khor lo gsum dang sgo mtshams brgyad/ /de mthar rgyal ba zhi khro dang*/ /steng du rdo rje 'chang la sogs/ /bskyed cing bstims nas phyi nang gsang*/ /yan lag bdun dang ting 'dzin gyi/ /dbang bzhi blangs te gsol gdab mang*/ /byas mthar 'khor rnams gtso bo la/ /bsdus te rang gi tshangs bug nas/ /zhugs nas rang gi rtsa 'khor nang*/ /mi shigs thig le'i dbus su ni/ hūṃ yig tshul du bla ma lha/ /rang sems dbyer med byas te bsam/ /rdzogs rim mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig /ma nus mod kyang de nyid kyis/ /rdzogs rim cha tsam mtshon par byas/ /de nas phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang*/ /dpa' mo thams cad bde mchog gi /lha mchog rnams dang dbyer med du/ /mos nas spyan drangs lus kyi char/ /thim zhugs mos shing sngags gsum gyis/ /lus dkyil nyid du gyur bsams te/ /bzlas pa thams cad rdzogs byas nas/

/smon lam btab cing mjug sdud byas/ /༈ de nas rang nyid mi bskyod par/ /bsgyur te mdun gyi nam mkha' ru/ /sngar bzhin pad sdong seng khri'i steng*/ /rje btsun btsong kha pa la sogs/ /'dus pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*/ /dbyer med rdo rje 'chang bskyed de/ /sku la lus dkyil lha bkod cing*/ /de mthar rnam snang la sogs pa/ / 'dus pa'i lha tshogs yi dam dang*/ /sangs rgyas byang sems la sogs kyis/ /bskor dang steng gi cha la ni/ /'dus pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /mdo sngags bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bskor nas bzhugs bskyed spyan drangs bstim/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ /yan lag bdun bcas byas pa'i mthar/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /rigs lnga'i sdom gzungs bcas byas te/ /dmigs brtse ma ni nyer gcig brjod/ /'on kyang rkang pa bzhi pa la/ / dbyer med rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes par bsgyur nas ton byas shing*/ /de tshe rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ /rje nyid rigs gsum mgon po rnams/ /dbyer med mos te gsol 'debs byas/ /de nas ting 'dzin dbang bzhi dang*/ /gsol gdab la sogs bde mchog skor/ /bshad bzhin bsgom bzlas rdzogs par byas/ /'on kyang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i tshogs/ /'dus pa'i lha dang dbyer med du/ /byas nas lus kyi cha rnams la/ /zhugs nas de dang dbyer med par/ /bzhugs mos rim gyis tshig brjod nas/ /gsal btab so so'i bzlas pa dang*/ /mthar ni yab yum sbyor mtshams nas/ /spros pa'i 'od zer phyogs bcur song*/ /sems can kun gyi sgrib sbyangs nas/ /hūṃ dang de rnams rdo rje 'chang*/ /nyid gyur rang la thim tshul sogs/ /bdag bskyed mjug tu 'byung ltar byas/ /༈ de nas rang nyid 'jigs byed du/ /bsgyur nas hūṃ yig 'od zer gyis/ /rang bzhin gnas nas gshin rje gshed/ /bcu gsum ma dang zhe dgu ma'i/ /lha tshogs bla brgyud bcas pa dang*/

/yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs/ /spyan drangs sngar bzhin pad sdong dbus/ /nyi ma'i gdan la 'jigs byed sogs/ /bcu gsum lha tshogs bzhugs mos nas/ /gtso bo rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang*/ /'khor rnams bsdus te gsal btab cing*/ /de mthar 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma'i/ /lha tshogs rnams dang mtha' skor du/ /yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs/ /sngar bzhin bzhugs par mos pa dang*/ /steng du 'jigs byed bla brgyud bcas/ /gsal gtab gang drin gzugs mchog sogs/ /rgyas bsdus skabs bstun phyi nang gi /mchod pa rnams sogs yan lag bdun/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa sdom bzung dang*/ /bstod pa dbang bzhi len pa sogs/ /gong du brjod pa lta bu dang*/ /gsol 'debs la sogs gsang 'dus kyi/ /skabs ltar byas te thugs ka yi/ /sa bon 'od kyis bcu gsum ma'i/ /lha tshogs sngar bzhin spyan drangs te/ /snying khar bzhugs mos sngags rnams bgrang*/ /bsngo smon mthar ni rdor sems su/ /bsgyur te kun rig rten brten pa'i/ /lha tshogs spyan drangs nam mkha' ru/ /bzhugs mos tshogs zhing bskyed tshul ltar/ /sngags brjod rim par gsal btab ste/ /bstod phyag yan lag bdun pa rnams/ / byas mthar slar yang bstod pa dang*/ /gzhan don gtsor dmigs gsol 'debs byas/ /༈ de nas rang gi snying kha ru/ /bzhugs par mos nas bzlas pa rnams/ /tshang bar byas shing rigs lnga las/ /rgyal mchog me tog cher rgyas kyi/ /gzungs ring gnyis kyang 'don par byas/ /de nas rang gzhan gnyis ka'i ched/ /'od dpag med dang mi 'khrugs pa/ /shāka thub bde gshegs mched bdun dang*/ /rgyal sras brgyad dang ye shes bla/ /'od kyi tog dang smon lam blo/ /dbang po zhi dang nam mkha' mdzod/ /sang sang po yi dbyangs la sogs/ /rgyal sras chen po 'ga' zhig rnams/ /lhan cig spyan drangs nam mkha' la/ /bzhugs par mos te so so yi/ /mtshan nas brjod de phyag 'tshal ba/ /dbyar dgun khyad kyis lan bdun nam/

/lnga rer bcas te mchod 'bul dang*/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs brjod cing*/ /yan lag bdun pa byas pa'i mthar/ /slar yang phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs su/ /bsgyur nas bdun lnga ci rigs dang*/ /rang gzhan phy-i mar bde can dang*/ /dga' ldan gnas su skyai ba yi/ /smon lam shugs drag legs par byas/ /mthar ni rang gi snying kha ru/ / bzhugs mos 'od dpag med nyid kyi/ /gzungs ring nyer gcig bcwo lnga sogs/ /brjod de bsngo smon dag kyang byas/ /de mthar sgrib sbyong ched dmigs te/ /sher snying lta ba dang 'brel dang*/ /seng gdong sngags bgrang bzlog pa'i khul/ /rang dang bstan dang 'gro don la/ /dmigs nas lan gsum thal brdab byas/ /de nas kun tu myur ba'i sogs/ /smon lam khyad par can 'ga' dang*/ / byams dang snying rje gtong len la/ /brten nas sbyong ba'i tshul zhig byas/ / mjug tu 'jigs byed mgon chos sogs/ /chos skyong rnams la gtor 'bul dang*/ /srung 'khor mtshon tsam bsgoms byas te/ /khro bcu'i snying po mi g.yo mgon/ /phyag rdor gtum po rta mgrin dang*/ /'jigs byed sngags gsum mtshon tsam dang*/ /rang nyid 'jigs byed du bsam pa'i/ /lus kyi gnas su yi ge dang*/ /lha 'ga' bkod de srung byas pa/ /yan gyi zhag gcig dge sbyor 'grub/ /'on kyang grong chog la sogs pa'i/ /rkyen gyis snga dro'i dge sbyong las/ /gsang bde 'jigs gsum mngon rtogs dang*/ /dpe thog 'don dgos la sogs pa/ /'ga' zhig chags mod gzungs rnams ni/ /zhar zhor rta thog sogs kun las/ /ton cing de bzhin sgrol ma dang*/ /rnam rgyal gzungs ring sogs kyang ngo*/ /gzhan ni gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang*/ /kun rig tshogs zhing la sogs 'ga'/ /rgyas bsdus khyad par ma gtogs par/ /nan tan ma chags byas pa'i khul/ /de ltar 'don tshan mang po la/ /zhugs 'di tshe rabs thams cad du/ /yi dam du mas byin rlob cing*/ /dgongs par 'gyur pa'i rten 'brel yod/

/ji skad smras pa 'di dag la/ /cung zad zhib cha ma thon pa/ /mchis mod re gnyis chad pa las/ /sgro btags lhag pa bkod med snyam/ /༈ zhor la kha cig gsung ba ltar/ /sngon gyi skye brgyud gang yin pa/ /rang gis gsal bar ma shes kyang*/ /sngon tshe rje yi bu slob zhig /yin 'dra bsam zhing tshe 'di'i sngon/ /btsun pa chos ldan zhig gam snyam/ /mdo na da lta yod pa yi/ /dpon gyi lo rgyus zhig tu ni/ /snga song rje drung rin po che/ /phyogs 'dir byon skabs dbon rgyud la/ /ko'u shri nang so 'byung ba dang*/ /lhan cig grags pa'i ming can zhig /'byung zhing de nyid dgon pa 'di/ /thog mar 'debs mkhan slob dpon pa/ /rin chen lhun po'i skye brgyud yin/ /de dang ko'u shri rnam pa gnyis/ /zung 'brel mdo sngags bstan pa nyid/ /rgyas par byed pa 'ong ngo zhes/ /lung bstan mdzad ces bkod snang ste/ /bden nam mi bden cang ma shes/ /mdzod dger yod pa'i sku rten pos/ /'di yi skye brgyud yin no zhes/ /brjod ces zer yang btang snyoms byas/ /bla chen 'ga' zhig 'di skad du/ /khyod nyid ma gcig la bsgron gyi/ /ma 'ongs lung bstan las zin cing*/ /slob dpon zla ba grags pa yi/ /slob ma mchog 'di'i skye brgyud tsam/ /rmi lam lta ngan yin snyam zer/ /gang ltar sngon gyi skye brgyud tsam/ /bzang bas phan thogs 'gyur dka' yi/ /rang gzhan dag la phan thogs pa'i/ /yon tan nyams len bcas pa dgos/ /med na tshe sngon tshangs pa dang*/ /brgya byin 'khor bsgyur la sogs kyi/ /skye ba bzung ba srid gyur te/ /de dag bzang bas rang nyid kyi/ /skye ba 'di phyir phan nam ci/ /gal te sangs rgyas byang sems kyi/ /sprul pa'i skye brgyud zhig yin na/ /dga' mod snyigs dus so skye la/ /de 'dra 'byung ba'i re ba ni/ /bdag lta rnams la ga la mchi/ /'on kyang ang dkar zhabs drung dang*/ /mched pa'i sku skye la sogs 'gas/

/skye brgyud gang yin dris byung tshe/ /lan ni 'debs rgyu don mthun zhig /ma rnyed de la 'di ltar brjod/ /sngon gyi skye ba 'di yin zhes/ /ngos bzung med kyang klu sgrub kyis/ / lam gsum thog tha dbus med par/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo mgal me yi/ / zhes sogs gsungs ltar skye brgyud yod/ /ces smras de 'dra don mthun yin/ / gzhan yang bla chen 'ga' zhig gi /rnam thar dag las sbyin bdag 'dis/ /rta nor 'di dang 'di phul sogs/ /bkod pa ltar na 'di lta bu/ /brjod na 'gal ba med snyam ste/ /de yang dkon mchog drin las ni/ /dngos po bzang mang rnyed pa las/ /dge slong sbyin pa phun tshogs nyid/ /dbus su 'gro skabs gos yug 'ga'/ /dar yug mang dang kha btags ni/ /stong dang lnga brgya'i skor rnams dang*/ /dngul srang nyis brgya bcas bskur te/ /ser 'bras dge gsum bkra shis lhun/ /rnams la mang ja rnam gzhag dang*/ /grwa tshang smad la kha btags kyi/ /'gyed dang khang tshan la dngul 'gyed/ /mtshon tsam bcas pa rnams byas shing*/ /rgyal dbang paṇa chen rnams gnyis la/ /rang dpags dngul gos 'bul chen dang*/ /de ka'i bla chen grags che 'gar/ /'bul ba'i mtshon byed rnam mang dang*/ /jo bo'i sku mdun brgya mchod sogs/ /dge rtsa che phra ci rigs bsgrubs/ /dgon 'dir rang nyid sleb pa nas/ /da lta'i bar du las sna yang*/ / lnga btang rgyud par 'gyed drug dang*/ /mtshan nyid grwa tshang 'gyed bdun byas/ / dbyar gnas skabs su 'gyed gcig dang*/ /khri thog yod dus dgu gtor skabs/ /'gyed phul lta bu 'dir ma bkod/ /spy-ir ni bsod nams tshogs gsog la/ /dkon mchog mchod dang sbyin gtong ni/ /mchog yin mod kyang thar 'dod kyis/ /byams dang snying rje lhag bsam dang*/ /lta ba smon lam rlabs chen rnams/ /byed pa phan yon che tshul ni/ /bzang spyod rdor gcod la sogs pa'i/ /mdo sde zab las bshad ltar yin/ /rtsom dpe po ti bcu lhag tsam/

/ bar du bsgrub pa'i rgyu rkyen la/ /gang song dngul phab brtsis byas na/ /dngul srang sum brgya lhag tsam zhig /brdzun med nges par song snang ngo*/ /dngos po 'ga' zhig skye yul dang*/ /gzhan gyis dbang med 'khyer gyur te/ /chud zos song ba dag kyang yod/ /gzhan yang pha ma dge tshul sogs/ /gshegs pa'i dge rtsa btang ba'i skor/ /'ga' zhig yod mod de thams cad/ /'di ru 'god par ma byas so/ /de ltar rnam thar thun mong dang*/ /thun mong min pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam/ /dad ldan 'ga' yis bskul ba'i ngor/ /ma sbas sgro skur med par bkod/ /rnam thar thun mong rnam gzhag mtshon tsam zhig /sngon nas bris zin sngon ma las lhag pa'i/ /brjod rgyu gzhan zhig brjod du mi snang yang*/ /nan tan bskul ba'i nan ngor 'di ltar bris/ /de yang thun mong min pa'i rnam thar mchog /brjod rgyu ma rnyed rnam thar thun mong ba'i/ /bya byed mchog dman mang pos sa bcad de/ /brjod 'dis mkhas rnams mgu bar mi nus shing*/ /don gnyer can dag spyod pa rgya mtsho'i nang*/ /rnam thar yid bzhin nor bu len 'dod kyang*/ /ma rnyed dgos chung rnam thar mching bu mang*/ /phyin thob lci ba'i khur gyis ngal snyam sems/ /de lta na yang dad stobs bskur ba'i dges/ /tshe rabs kun tu lha mi'i rten rnyed cing*/ /dam pa'i mgon gyis brtse bas rjes bzung nas/ / myur du rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces pa 'di ni/

khya dge'i slob dpon rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgya mtsho'i gdan sa ba sku skye sngags rams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sogs bla chen 'ga' zhig dang*/ khyad par co ne'i sa skyong chen po 'jam dbyangs nor bus rnam thar 'di lta bu zhig bgyis zhes gsung gis bskur ba ltar/ shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis g.yar khral du sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/slob dpon bshad sgrub ming can gyi rnam thar zur ba gzur gnas dga' byed bzhugs/ -PAGE 280--PAGE 279--PAGE 278-
